# CHROs on the GO

Everyone who steps into a new role moves the needle. Here we shine a light on the CHROs who are shaping how work is led, felt, and grown across Europe.

This is a curated snapshot of fresh appointments. Leaders who set a people-first tone, open clearer paths for talent, elevate culture, and help teams do their best work.

Explore the moves, meet the leaders, and see where momentum is building.

# CHROs on the GO

Everyone who steps into a new role moves the needle. Here we shine a light on the CHROs who are shaping how work is led, felt, and grown across Europe.

This is a curated snapshot of fresh appointments. Leaders who set a people-first tone, open clearer paths for talent, elevate culture, and help teams do their best work.

Explore the moves, meet the leaders, and see where momentum is building.

## October 2026

* * *

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/39.png)

##### **Julius Baer Group appoints Francis Hoefman as Chief Human Resources Officer**  **(October, 2026)**

Julius Baer Group (Switzerland, wealth management group) has appointed Francis Hoefman as Chief Human Resources Officer and member of its Global Wealth Management Committee, effective January 11, 2027. She succeeds Guido Ruoss, who spent 18 years at Julius Baer, the last 11 leading the group’s HR function, and who is leaving to take on a new challenge outside the group. Hoefman joins from Reckitt, where she most recently served as Senior Vice President HR, Group Talent, Leadership, Categories and R&D, leading a global HR organisation of around 500 professionals; she also led the global HR organisation for the Hygiene and Health business divisions. Earlier in her career she held senior HR roles at H.J. Heinz and Mars. She brings more than 20 years of experience across people, business strategy and organisational transformation, and will drive the bank’s people agenda.

**[More information](https://www.juliusbaer.com/en/media/news-portal/julius-baer-appoints-francis-hoefman-as-chief-human-resources-officer/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/40.png)

##### **MANGO promotes Marlies Hersbach as Chief People Officer**  **(October, 2026)**

MANGO (Spain, fashion retailer) has promoted Marlies Hersbach to Chief People Officer, effective January 2027. Reporting directly to CEO Toni Ruiz, she will lead the entire human resources function, succeeding David Payeras, who leaves the company in January 2027. Hersbach, a member of the Executive Committee since July 2025, currently serves as Chief Online and Customer Officer. She joined MANGO in 2020 as International Retail Director and became E-commerce Executive Director in 2024; before MANGO she worked for Kiabi and Pimkie. In her new role she will focus on aligning culture and values with business strategy, developing MANGO as an international company, and promoting internal talent and women in leadership.

**[More information](https://fashionunited.uk/news/people/mango-promotes-marlies-hersbach-to-chief-people-officer/2026101490848)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/41.png)

##### **ZEISS Group appoints Ingolf Thom as Head of Corporate Human Resources and CHRO**  **(October, 2026)**

The ZEISS Group (Germany, technology company) has appointed Ingolf Thom as Head of Corporate Human Resources and CHRO, effective October 1, 2026, succeeding Florian Mezger. He joins from the Finnish packaging manufacturer Huhtamaki, where he served as Executive Vice President Human Resources and Safety. His earlier roles include Chief Human Resources Officer at K+S Group and Global Human Resources Director at DowDuPont.

**[More information](https://www.humanresourcesmanager.de/personalwechsel/ingolf-thom-ist-neuer-leiter-corporate-human-resources-und-chro-bei-zeiss/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/42.png)

##### **Salling Group appoints Henriette Gabel as Chief People Officer**  **(October, 2026)**

Salling Group (Denmark/Europe, a leading Danish retail and e-commerce conglomerate operating store formats including Netto, Føtex, and Bilka) has appointed Henriette Gabel as Chief People Officer (CPO). Henriette brings extensive international HR leadership experience across retail, manufacturing, and industrial sectors. She joins Salling Group from Nobia, where she served as Executive Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer, having previously held senior global talent leadership positions at Vestas. Reporting to CEO Anders Hagh and the executive leadership team, Henriette oversees Salling Group’s people and culture strategy. Her primary mandate focuses on scaling workforce capabilities, driving organizational transformation, and supporting the retailer’s strategic growth initiatives.

**[More information](https://hrtoday.in/salling-group-appoints-henriette-gabel-as-chief-people-officer-effective-january-2027/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/43.png)

##### **Avon appoints Paul Gilliam as Chief People Officer**  **(October, 2026)**

Avon (UK, global beauty company) has appointed Paul Gilliam as Chief People Officer. He will lead HR through the reintegration of Avon’s North American business, with a focus on organisational design, succession planning, industrial relations and employee engagement, as well as attracting marketing and product development talent and developing leaders internally. He has held senior HR leadership positions at Claire’s, L’Oréal, Air France-KLM and Unilever.

**[More information](https://hrchiefmagazine.com/news/paul-gilliam-joins-avon-as-chief-people-officer)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/44.png)

##### **Nomad Foods appoints Pınar Çanakcı as Chief People Officer**  **(October, 2026)**

Nomad Foods (UK, frozen food company) has appointed Pınar Çanakcı as Chief People Officer, effective October 19, 2026. Reporting directly to CEO Dominic Brisby, she joins the Executive Team and will lead the global people agenda, including talent development, organisational effectiveness, culture, employee engagement and HR strategy. Pınar joins from Danone, where she spent 14 years in senior global and regional HR leadership roles, most recently as Vice President Human Resources for Asia, Middle East and Africa. She has also held HR leadership roles at Kimberly-Clark and Mercer HR Consulting, and brings more than 20 years of international experience across FMCG, telecommunications and consulting.

**[More information](https://www.nomadfoods.com/article/nomad-foods-announces-appointment-of-chief-people-officer/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/45.png)

##### **Barmenia Gothaer promotes Dr. Sylvia Eichelberg as Arbeitsdirektorin (Labour Director)** **(October, 2026)**

The Barmenia Gothaer Group (Germany, insurance group) has named Dr. Sylvia Eichelberg as Arbeitsdirektorin (Labour Director), responsible for human resources, effective January 1, 2027. She has served as Chief Operating Officer of BarmeniaGothaer since the merger of Barmenia and Gothaer in September 2024. She previously served as Chair of the Management Board of Gothaer Krankenversicherung AG and, before that, as Head of P&C SME and Executive Director at AXA.

**[More information](https://www.humanresourcesmanager.de/personalwechsel/dr-sylvia-eichelberg-wird-arbeitsdirektorin-von-gothaer-barmenia/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/46.png)

##### **McDonald’s UK and Ireland promotes Danielle Harris as Chief People Officer** **(October, 2026)**

McDonald’s UK and Ireland has appointed Danielle Harris as Chief People Officer, effective October 2026. She succeeds James Thorne, who moves to a senior leadership role in McDonald’s global people team in the US, leading the people pillar of the McDonald’s > Next strategy. Harris has more than 12 years at McDonald’s; her roles there have included Vice President, Global People Partner for Corporate Functions, US segment talent lead, Atlanta field people officer and global talent strategy leader, and she has led people strategy across more than 1,500 restaurants in the south-eastern US. She will lead the people agenda across the UK and Ireland business, working with franchisees to support talent, engagement and development.

**[More information](https://www.employeebenefits.co.uk/total-reward/2026/10/12/mcdonalds-uk-and-ireland-appoints-chief-people-officer/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/47.png)

##### **Elektrobit elevates Christine Kirbach to Chief People & Technology Officer**  **(October, 2026)**

Elektrobit (Germany/Global, a visionary global supplier of embedded and connected software products for the automotive industry) has appointed Christine Kirbach as Chief People & Technology Officer. Christine brings extensive executive leadership experience bridging human resources, organizational development, and technology operations within the automotive software and IT sectors. She previously served in senior HR and operational leadership roles within Elektrobit and its parent ecosystem. Reporting to the executive leadership team, Christine oversees the combined global people and technology strategies, focusing on driving digital transformation, scaling agile workforce structures, and aligning tech infrastructure with talent development.

**[More information](https://hrtoday.in/christine-kirbach-elevated-to-chief-people-technology-officer-at-elektrobit/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/48.png)

##### **Open Cosmos appoints Natasha Dillon as Chief People Officer**  **(October, 2026)**

Open Cosmos (UK, space company with offices in Spain, Portugal and Greece) has appointed Natasha Dillon as Chief People Officer. She will lead the people function, covering talent acquisition and development, leadership, structures and culture, as the company scales internationally. Most recently she was Senior Managing Director for Value Creation at British Columbia Investment Management Corporation. Earlier she served as Chief Portfolio People Officer at Apax Partners, covering people and talent across 70 portfolio companies, and spent seven years as Chief People Officer at Inmarsat.

**[More information](https://www.employeebenefits.co.uk/global-reward/2026/11/02/open-cosmos-appoints-new-chief-people-officer/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/49.png)

##### **Ilionx appoints Marlon Woudstra as CHRO**  **(October, 2026)**

Ilionx (Netherlands, Utrecht-based IT services provider with about 1,100 employees) has appointed Marlon Woudstra as CHRO, effective October 1, 2026. She joins the management team and general management alongside CEO Bas de Reus and CFO Nick Denee. She previously served as CHRO at Flextender, a platform and broker for external staffing, and spent seven years as CHRO at Continu Professionals, part of House of HR.

**[More information](https://chro.nl/artikel/marlon-woudstra-is-de-nieuwe-chro-bij-it-dienstverlener-ilionx/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/50.png)

##### **ILIAS Solutions elevates Sebastiaan Brouwers to Chief Human Resources Officer**  **(October, 2026)**

ILIAS Solutions (Belgium/Global, a leading provider of defense and aerospace enterprise resource planning software) has elevated Sebastiaan Brouwers to Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO). Sebastiaan brings extensive HR leadership experience specializing in talent management, organizational development, and workforce scaling within the technology and defense software sectors. He previously served in senior human resources leadership roles within ILIAS Solutions. Reporting to the executive management team, Sebastiaan leads the company’s global human capital strategy, focusing on expanding workforce capabilities, strengthening talent pipelines, and supporting international software delivery growth.

**[More information](https://hrtoday.in/sebastiaan-brouwers-elevated-to-chief-human-resources-officer-at-ilias-solutions/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/51.png)

##### **Diamant Software appoints Thomas Lassahn as Chief Human Resources Officer**  **(October, 2026)**

Diamant Software (Germany, Bielefeld-based software company with more than 350 employees) has appointed Thomas Lassahn as Chief Human Resources Officer; he has held the role since September 2026. He is responsible for the company’s HR strategy, including the development of leaders and employees. He previously served as Vice President People & Culture DACH and, before that, Director People & Culture at group.one, and as Vice President Human Resources at Majorel Deutschland.

**[More information](https://www.humanresourcesmanager.de/personalwechsel/thomas-lassahn-ist-chro-bei-diamant-software/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/52.png)

##### **BE Shaping the Future UK elevates Emma Williams as Chief People Officer**  **(October, 2026)**

BE Shaping the Future UK (UK, a specialized management consulting and financial services technology firm) has elevated Emma Williams to Chief People Officer (CPO).Emma brings extensive human resources leadership experience specializing in talent management, organizational development, and strategic workforce planning within financial services and consulting sectors. She previously held senior HR leadership roles within BE Shaping the Future’s UK operations. Reporting to executive leadership, Emma oversees the firm’s UK people and culture strategy, focusing on scaling professional talent pipelines, driving employee engagement, and supporting consulting practice growth.

**[More information](https://hrtoday.in/be-shaping-the-future-uk-elevates-emma-williams-as-chief-people-officer/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/53.png)

##### **Schindler Group appoints Dr. André Becker as Chief Human Resources**  **(October, 2026)**

Schindler Group (Switzerland, elevator and escalator manufacturer) has appointed Dr. André Becker as Chief Human Resources and member of the Group Executive Committee, effective January 1, 2027. He previously served as Chief Human Resources Officer and Executive Board Member at Lidl, with global HR responsibility, and earlier held leadership roles at BASF, including more than two and a half years with executive management responsibility for its North American chemicals business. Since 2024 he has worked independently as an adviser to senior executives and companies going through demanding transformations.

**[More information](https://group.schindler.com/en/media/press-releases/changes-to-the-group-executive-committee-september-25.html)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/54.png)

##### **Fendi appoints Camilla Maggiori as Chief People Officer**  **(September, 2026)**

Fendi (Italy, luxury fashion house, part of the LVMH Group) has appointed Camilla Maggiori as Chief People Officer; she has served in the role since December 2025. She previously spent nearly three years as Group Chief People Officer at Ferragamo. Her earlier roles include Global SVP Talent, HRBP Digital & Growth Initiatives at Coty, Global Head of Talent & Culture at Campari Group and Global Vice President Talent Management, Internal Communication & HRIS at Radisson Hotel Group, as well as talent roles at Amcor and Procter & Gamble.

**[More information](https://www.peoplematters.in/news/leadership/fendi-appoints-camilla-maggiori-as-chief-people-officer-52390)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/55.png)

##### **Porminho appoints Pedro Cunha as Chief People Officer**  **(October, 2026)**

Porminho (Portugal, a leading food manufacturing company specializing in meat products) has appointed Pedro Cunha as Chief People Officer (CHRO/CPO). Pedro brings over 20 years of international executive HR and operational leadership experience, having previously led large-scale industrial transformations, M&A integrations, and cross-functional corporate services across Europe and Africa. Partnering directly with the Board and Executive Committee, he leads Porminho’s group-wide people strategy, focusing on modernizing the HR operating model, scaling industrial workforce capabilities, driving AI-enabled digital HR practices, and strengthening talent governance.

**[More information](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pedro-cunha-bb339418b/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/56.png)

##### **Ariel Re appoints Tamsin Webster as Chief People Officer**  **(October, 2026)**

Ariel Re (global reinsurance business; role based in the UK) has appointed Tamsin Webster as Chief People Officer. She joins from ECI Partners, where she was Head of People and set up the firm’s first internal HR function. She previously served as Chief People Officer at Fulcrum Asset Management and held senior HR leadership roles at UBS, BlackRock and Lloyds Banking Group, bringing more than 20 years of global HR leadership across financial services, technology and private equity-backed businesses. CEO Ryan Mather said her talent development expertise will help strengthen Ariel Re’s position as an “academy firm”.

**[More information](https://www.employeebenefits.co.uk/total-reward/2026/10/26/ariel-re-names-new-chief-people-officer/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/57.png)

##### **NIC Services Group appoints Kelly Dolphin as Chief People Officer**  **(October, 2026)**

NIC Services Group (UK & Ireland, a leading family-owned soft services and facilities management provider) has appointed Kelly Dolphin as Chief People Officer (CPO). Kelly brings extensive human resources leadership experience specializing in people operations, organizational development, and employee engagement within the facilities management and service sectors, including previous senior leadership roles at SBFM and Atalian Servest. Reporting to executive leadership, Kelly leads NIC’s group-wide people strategy, focusing on scaling talent operations, driving workforce engagement, and supporting regional expansion across the UK and Ireland.

**[More information](https://hrtoday.in/kelly-dolphin-appointed-chief-people-officer-at-nic-services-group-ltd/)**

## September 2026

* * *

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/250.png)

##### **AXA appoints Astrid Panosyan-Bouvet as Group Chief Human Resources Officer**  **(September, 2026)**

AXA (France, global insurance and financial services leader) has appointed Astrid Panosyan-Bouvet as Group Chief Human Resources Officer, effective 1 September 2026, and she also joins the Management Committee. Reporting to Deputy General Secretary Karima Silvent, she will lead Group-level HR functions including talent management, compensation, culture, diversity, HR operations, social relations, and learning and development. She returns to AXA, where she began her career in M&A from 1998 to 2001, after serving as France’s Minister for Labour and Employment (2024–2025) and a Member of the French National Assembly. Her corporate background also includes senior leadership roles at Groupama and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield, and a board seat at Air France-KLM. In her new role, CEO Thomas Buberl says her experience with culture, lifelong learning and diversity will be a strategic asset as she aligns human capital initiatives with AXA’s next strategic plan.

**[More information](https://hrchiefmagazine.com/news/axa-appoints-ex-minister-astrid-panosyan-bouvet-as-hr-chief)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/34.png)

##### **Maersk appoints Roberta Duarte as Chief People Officer**  **(September, 2026)**

A.P. Moller – Maersk (Denmark/Global, integrated logistics company) has appointed Roberta Duarte as Chief People Officer, effective November 1, 2026, returning to the company after a decade there between 2014 and 2024. She joins Maersk’s Executive Leadership Team, succeeding Susana Elvira, who is leaving after 24 years with the company. Duarte joins from Werfen, where she currently serves as Chief People Officer, and previously held senior People leadership roles at Maersk across Asia Pacific, Latin America and Ocean & Logistics. Earlier in her career she worked at Citibank across Latin and North America.

**[More information](https://hrtoday.in/roberta-duarte-to-join-maersk-as-chief-people-officer/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/35.png)

##### **Sainsbury’s appoints Paula Coughlan as Chief People Officer**  **(September, 2026)**

Sainsbury’s (UK, one of the UK’s largest retailers) has named Paula Coughlan as Chief People Officer, effective January 2027. She will join the Operating Board and report directly to Chief Executive Officer Simon Roberts, with a leadership agenda focused on culture, colleague experience and performance. She joins from Currys plc, where she has served as Chief People, Communications and Sustainability Officer since 2022, having originally joined Currys in 2019 as Chief People Officer. Her earlier background includes senior global HR leadership roles at McDonald’s, including Corporate VP and Chief People Strategy Officer, Global, and more than eight years at PepsiCo across organizational development, talent management and HR leadership roles in Europe.

**[More information](https://hrtoday.in/sainsburys-names-paula-coughlan-as-chief-people-officer/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/31.png)

##### **Kerry appoints Lisa Turley as Chief Human Resources Officer**  **(September, 2026)**

Kerry (Ireland, global leader in taste and nutrition solutions) has appointed Lisa Turley as Chief Human Resources Officer. She will work alongside the Executive Team to shape and advance the company’s people, talent and leadership strategies as Kerry moves into its next phase of growth. Turley takes on the role after more than a decade at Kerry, most recently as Vice President, Group Head of Leadership, Learning & Talent, and previously as Vice President, Human Resources, partnering with the Global Chief Operating Officer across a supply chain organization of approximately 12,500 colleagues. Earlier in her career she spent more than five years at First Data Corporation, rising to Vice President, Global HR Operations. She brings more than 25 years of HR experience across global leadership, talent, learning and organizational effectiveness.

**[More information](https://hrtoday.in/kerry-appoints-lisa-turley-as-chief-human-resources-officer/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/32.png)

##### **argenx promotes Loes Bresseleers to Global Head of HR**  **(September, 2026)**

argenx (Belgium, global immunology company) has elevated Loes Bresseleers to Global Head of HR, expanding her leadership mandate as the company enters its next phase of growth. She steps into the role after more than two years at argenx, most recently as Global Head HR – R&D, CMC, Quality, Business & Corporate Development. She joins from more than 11 years at Johnson & Johnson, where she held increasingly senior HR leadership roles across Europe, Africa and global functions, including Head of HR, Global Enterprise Functions – Quality and Compliance, and Head of HR for Switzerland and South Africa. Earlier she spent more than four years at ING Belgium as a Recruitment & Selection Officer and HR Business Partner.

**[More information](https://hrtoday.in/argenx-elevates-loes-bresseleers-to-global-head-of-hr/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/33.png)

##### **Volkswagen AG appoints Erika Rasch as Board Member for Human Resources (Arbeitsdirektorin)**  **(September, 2026)**

Volkswagen AG (Germany, global automotive manufacturer) has appointed Erika Rasch to its Group Board of Management with responsibility for Personnel, taking the statutory Arbeitsdirektorin (Labour/Works Director) seat, effective October 1, 2026. She succeeds Thomas Schäfer, who had held the role on an interim basis since July 2025 after it stood vacant for over a year. Erika joins from Robert Bosch Group, where she served as Global Head of HR, and previously held senior HR leadership roles at BSH Home Appliances Group and across Bosch’s Mobility Solutions and Automotive Steering businesses. She brings extensive HR experience within large international automotive and industrial organisations to the role.

**[More information](https://www.humanresourcesmanager.de/personalwechsel/erika-rasch-wird-personalvorstaendin-bei-vw/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/28.png)

##### **CH Media appoints Eda Rettinger as Chief Human Resources Officer**  **(September, 2026)**

CH Media (Switzerland, media group) has appointed Eda Rettinger as Chief Human Resources Officer and a member of its executive leadership team. She succeeds Lydia Zollinger, who departed voluntarily after four years building the HR function. Eda joins from Calida AG, where she was Director of Human Resources and an executive board member from 2021-2024, and previously held a CHRO position at ARX (formerly Pini Group). She brings around 20 years of experience in People & Culture, organisational development, transformation and digitalisation to the role.

**[More information](https://www.humanresourcesmanager.de/personalwechsel/eda-rettinger-hat-die-leitung-human-resources-von-ch-media-uebernommen/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/29.png)

##### **Allfunds appoints Ana Marshall as Chief People Officer**  **(September, 2026)**

Allfunds (Spain/Global, leading B2B wealthtech and fund distribution platform) has appointed Ana Marshall as Chief People Officer and a member of the Executive Committee. Reporting to CEO Annabel Spring, Ana will drive the company’s people strategy, organisational change and corporate governance as Allfunds expands globally into ETFs, alternatives and blockchain innovation. She brings more than two decades of senior HR experience from JPMorgan Chase, where she most recently served as Head of Human Resources for the EMEA region (excluding the UK), and previously served as Chief Executive Officer of Fundación Álex Rivera. In her new role she will focus on attracting exceptional talent and building a highly inclusive workplace culture.

**[More information](https://hrchiefmagazine.com/news/allfunds-appoints-ana-marshall-as-chief-people-officer)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/30.png)

##### **Uniper appoints Eva Schwarz as Executive Vice President People & Organisation**  **(September, 2026)**

Uniper (Germany, major international energy company) has appointed Eva Schwarz as Executive Vice President People & Organisation. She joins from Amprion, the German electricity transmission system operator, where she spent more than six years as HR Director and Head of Personnel. Schwarz’s background also includes senior HR leadership roles at Innogy, an E.ON subsidiary, including Head of HR Enabling Function (Corporate) and HR Business Partner positions. In her new role she will lead the expansion of Future Skills and the further development of Employee Experience at Uniper as the company continues its ongoing transformation.

**[More information](https://www.humanresourcesmanager.de/personalwechsel/eva-schwarz-ist-neue-executive-vice-president-people-organisation-bei-uniper/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/25.png)

##### **Currys promotes Caroline Hirst as Chief People Officer**  **(September, 2026)**

Currys (UK, consumer electronics retailer) has promoted Caroline Hirst to Chief People Officer. Reporting to Group Chief Executive Fredrik Tønnesen, she succeeds Paula Coughlan, who is leaving to become Chief People Officer at Sainsbury’s from January 2027. Caroline was previously Group Talent, Leadership and Learning Director at Currys, a role she has held since joining in 2025. Before that she spent about two decades in senior HR roles at Diageo and Haleon. In her new role she will lead people strategy and talent, and will also oversee communications and sustainability, including the net zero by 2040 target. She will also support the retailer’s digital transformation and the training of its workforce for AI adoption.

**[More information](https://hrchiefmagazine.com/news/currys-names-caroline-hirst-as-chief-people-officer)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/26.png)

##### **Givenchy appoints Nicky Grays as Head of HR**  **(September, 2026)**

Givenchy (France, LVMH-owned luxury fashion house) has appointed Nikeia (Nicky) Grays as global Head of HR. She reports to CEO Amandine Ohayon and joins the executive committee alongside newly appointed CMO Alistair McCallum, as part of the house’s global repositioning. She joins from LVMH Fashion Group, where she was Head of HR for the Americas division for three years. Her earlier senior roles include Farfetch, Stadium Goods and Moda Operandi. In her new role she will lead Givenchy’s global talent strategy and support its international expansion. She will also focus on attracting top creative and commercial talent and building a cohesive culture.

**[More information](https://hrchiefmagazine.com/news/givenchy-names-nicky-grays-as-head-of-hr)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/27.png)

##### **HaysMac appoints Matthew Clarke as Chief People Officer**  **(September, 2026)**

HaysMac (UK, London-based accountancy and tax advisory firm) has appointed Matthew Clarke as Chief People Officer, a newly created role. He joins the management team from Deloitte, where he was HR Director for Audit and Assurance and Firmwide Business Partnering. In his new role he will set people strategy for more than 650 employees across London and Cape Town. His focus includes leadership capability and colleague experience, as the firm works towards a £100 million revenue target.

**[More information](https://hrchiefmagazine.com/news/haysmac-names-matthew-clarke-as-new-chief-people-officer)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/22.png)

##### **BG Kliniken promotes Elisabeth Westerholt as Head of Human Resources**  **(September, 2026)**

BG Kliniken (Germany, hospital group run by the statutory accident insurance system) has promoted Elisabeth Westerholt to Head of Human Resources (Ressortleiterin Personal) at the group’s parent company. She was previously the group’s area manager for personnel, a role she took in 2022 after joining BG Kliniken’s HR department in 2019. She is also an authorised signatory (Prokuristin) of the subsidiary BG Kliniken Services gGmbH. Before BG Kliniken she was a personnel specialist at Berlin’s Vivantes hospital network. In her new role she leads strategic HR across the whole clinic group.

**[More information](https://www.humanresourcesmanager.de/personalwechsel/elisabeth-westerholt-ist-neue-ressortleiterin-personal-der-bg-kliniken/)**

![](https://www.kennedyfitch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/23.png)

##### **Rimes appoints Susanna Yallop as Chief People Officer**  **(September, 2026)**

Rimes (UK/US, enterprise data management and investment intelligence provider headquartered in London and New York) has appointed Susanna Yallop as Chief People Officer, based in London, effective September 2026.
